name: p99_hv0_hand_workspace_visual_expert
hypothesis: Dynamic hand/workspace crops encoded before VideoMAE pooling preserve small object-interaction evidence that is diluted in global early/late visual features.
selection: The main hand_all representation must be information-bearing, improve hard complementarity over the same-backbone global VideoMAEv2 expert, and rescue anchor errors in at least three held users before any anchor fusion is designed.
h2_policy: H1-only representation audit. H2 and Student require a separately frozen recipe after H1; H3 has no code path.
